name: Unity USD

collateral: BSC stablecoin and crypto collateral managed by the UUSD protocol

mintAuthority.summary: Unity USD (UUSD) is an upgradeable Ownable proxy ERC-20 on BSC operated by Anything Labs; supply is issuer/owner-controlled and the implementation can be upgraded by the owner, but the project publishes no verifiable collateral or mint-route documentation.

controls.label: UUSD owner / proxy upgrade admin
controls.evidence: BscScan shows UUSD is an upgradeable proxy (implementation 0xA4f44c290CC693fC0c985d679281c61e99d9Be9a) with an Ownable owner; the owner can upgrade the implementation and controls supply, but the mint route and collateral process are not documented.

review.evidence: BscScan shows the UUSD token is an upgradeable proxy with Ownable owner control over the implementation; the issuer (Anything Labs) markets UUSD as reserve-backed for an AI-agent economy but publishes no audited reserve attestation or specific mint mechanism, so issuance is treated as issuer/owner-controlled.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Owner-controlled upgradeable proxy confirmed from BscScan; the actual mint authorization path and collateral backing are undocumented, so the issuer-direct/owner-controlled classification is the best-supported reading rather than a fully opaque unknown.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/upgrade-admin address and whether a distinct minter role or off-chain reserve backs issued UUSD supply.
